description: Finite set S of single-qubit density matrices given by exact-rational Bloch vectors. Probe family M = {X, Y, Z} Pauli expectations. This file is pure DATA (state coordinates + probe identities). Each engine leg reads it and computes the probe-expectation invariant and the quotient S/~_M independently; no engine ships a precomputed invariant here.
indistinguishability_definition: rho_a ~_M rho_b  iff  tr(rho_a P) == tr(rho_b P) for every probe P in M
flip_claim: s1 and s2 are distinguishable under M={X,Y,Z} (separated by Z) but indistinguishable under M={X,Y} (Z erased). The SMT proof asks 'does an active probe separate s1,s2?' -> SAT under full M, UNSAT under erased M. This is a real-vs-erased structural flip over the exact expectation values, not a count assertion.

lineage.F01: simultaneous-distinguishability surface: a probe family acts on the finite set at once; ~_M is the joint kernel of the probe expectations.
lineage.N01: order/persistence note: the probe expectations tr(rho P) are read on a fixed finite set; this rung exercises the F01 distinguishability surface only and makes no N01 order-gap claim.
lineage.root_axiom: a = a iff a ~ b -- identity here is the equivalence class S/~_M, probe-relative, not primitive.
